verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Shopify POS tracks and assigns inventory at every location and syncs it in real time across POS, the online store and every sales channel. In-POS tools also update stock: Quick counts with a barcode scanner, receiving incoming shipments, and exchanges that update inventory instantly. One community report of an integer-overflow bug breaking inventory counts is a single bug report, not a refutation of sync, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of creating and editing catalog items and attributes (one community commenter cites a lack of custom product fields), and independent hands-on corroboration that sync works reliably across registers.
